content.user_title: Add polished overlays to talking-head videos
content.value_statement: Talking-head videos can need clear visual structure without replacing the original footage. This skill creates timed graphic overlays from a local video and its transcript.
actual_capabilities: Extracts local video metadata and audio with ffprobe and ffmpeg.
Creates a local Whisper transcript with word-level timestamps.
Plans timed overlay cards from a corrected transcript.
Builds titles, lower-thirds, quotes, callouts, side panels, and picture-in-picture layouts.
Renders an assembled HTML composition to an MP4 with HyperFrames.
limitations: Requires a local input video, ffmpeg, ffprobe, and HyperFrames rendering dependencies.
Overlay quality depends on transcript accuracy and the supplied footage.
It does not create new footage or replace the underlying video content.
It does not provide plain subtitle-only workflows.

use_cases.title: Package a podcast clip
use_cases.description: Add quotes, speaker labels, and data callouts to a podcast excerpt.

use_cases.title: Improve an interview video
use_cases.description: Add lower-thirds and timed context cards to an existing interview.

use_cases.title: Prepare social video variants
use_cases.description: Adapt overlay layouts for portrait, landscape, or 4:5 delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Start with one video
prompt_templates.prompt: Add simple title and lower-third overlays to my local interview video. Use the recommended aspect ratio and a restrained style.

prompt_templates.title: Create a podcast package
prompt_templates.prompt: Package this podcast clip with transcript-synced quote cards, speaker labels, and two data callouts. Keep the video visible beneath the graphics.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a portrait cut
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 version of this talking-head video. Use picture-in-picture only when it improves readability, and use six timed graphic cards.

prompt_templates.title: Direct the visual system
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 16:9 talking-head recut with an editorial theme, side panels for metrics, short kinetic title moments, and card timings based on meaningful transcript transitions.

output_examples.input: A five-minute interview clip with product metrics.
output: A transcript-synced plan for graphic cards.
Lower-thirds and metric callouts timed to relevant remarks.
A rendered MP4 with the original interview playing underneath.

output_examples.input: A portrait podcast excerpt for social media.
output: A 9:16 composition with readable overlay bounds.
Quote and speaker cards that preserve the source video.
A final MP4 ready for review.

best_practices: Review and correct names, numbers, and technical terms in the transcript before planning overlays.
Keep cards short and place them only at meaningful moments in the speech.
Preview the rendered video and verify that overlays do not hide important visual content.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for subtitle-only requests.
Do not add a graphic card for every sentence in the transcript.
Do not use unverified transcript text for names, prices, or factual claims.

faq.question: What video does this skill support?
faq.answer: It is designed for an existing local talking-head, interview, or podcast video.

faq.question: Does it change the original footage?
faq.answer: No. The source clip remains underneath the timed graphic overlays.

faq.question: Can it create plain subtitles?
faq.answer: No. Use a subtitle-focused workflow for plain captions.

faq.question: Does transcription require an API key?
faq.answer: The documented workflow uses local Whisper through HyperFrames and does not require an API key.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: The workflow requires HyperFrames, ffmpeg, ffprobe, and the required rendering dependencies.
